anchor_definition: The anchor is td: the password encoder invoked by the login dispatcher (_action sets h.password=td(f)). Its body scrambles the password into a fixed-position random-padded string (inserting password substrings at indices 7 and 12 among random characters) and encodes it, producing the observed password token. cryp is a sibling encoder for other data, not the password.

anchor.why: Scrambles the password a into a 15-slot array of random chars with a.substr(0,3) inserted at index 7 and a.substr(3) at index 12, then encodes the joined result — the observed base64 password token. Called as h.password=td(f) inside the login _action.

roles.why: A different scrambling/encoding routine (URL-encodes then permutes its input); not the password encoder td. A sibling decoy.
